On Wed, Apr 24, 2013 at 10:29 AM, Marc Mazerolle <maze...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hello unmarked users,
>
> I recently implemented the MacKenzie and Bailey Pearson chi-square test to
> assess the goodness-of-fit of single season occupancy models fit with
> unmarked. It is now available (mb.gof.test( ) ) in package AICcmodavg 1.29.
> I also prepared a small function to get SE's for predictions of ZIP models
> from pcount and pcountOpen, which may also be useful to unmarked users.
>
> Best,
>
> Marc
